name: Pulse Meds
tagline: Daily medication reminders. Your phone. Your records.
overview: Pulse Meds is a medication reminder for people who take daily meds. It shows your next dose with a countdown, reminds you at the right time, and asks you to confirm before anything is logged. It keeps your medications, supply count and history on your phone, with no account and no subscription. Medical light by default, Pulse dark one tap away. It is a reminder and record-keeping tool, not a medical device.

capabilities.title: First run
capabilities.text: A welcome screen that says what the app is before asking anything, then a choice of look: Medical light, Pulse dark or Follow my phone.

proofs.caption: Welcome: works offline, no account, no subscription

capabilities.title: Home and next dose
capabilities.text: Home shows the next dose big, with a live countdown (or how late it is), and one-tap doors to the main screens.

proofs.caption: Home: the dose due now, how late it is, and the main doors

capabilities.title: Everything in one tap
capabilities.text: Twelve doors: Today's Doses, My Medications, Add, Refills, History and Undo, Emergency, Personal Info, Medical History, Health Diary, Documents, Appointments, Desk Display, plus Reports and Data.

capabilities.title: Menu and manual
capabilities.text: The menu holds Help, What's New, Replay Tips, Settings, Profiles, Report a Problem and About. The manual explains each task in numbered steps.

proofs.caption: Help / Manual: Take a dose, step by step

capabilities.title: Search
capabilities.text: Type in the search bar on Home to find a medication, with a plain answer when nothing matches.

capabilities.title: Add a medication
capabilities.text: A five-step guide: name and strength, time and dose, label photo, pill photo, supply count. You can save a draft and finish later.

capabilities.title: Schedules
capabilities.text: Once a day or several times a day, free. Every other day, weekly and custom patterns come with the one-time unlock.

proofs.caption: Once a day at a set time, or add more times

capabilities.title: Full-screen reminder
capabilities.text: When a dose is due the reminder can take over the screen, even over the lock screen, with big Taken, Snooze and Skip buttons.

capabilities.title: Talking reminder
capabilities.text: An optional voice reads the dose aloud using the phone's own offline voice.

capabilities.title: Reminder notification
capabilities.text: At dose time a notification arrives with Taken, Snooze and Skip. Taken opens the confirm screen, so nothing is recorded by accident.

proofs.caption: The reminder arrives at dose time
Taken, Snooze and Skip right in the notification
Tap Taken: the app opens the confirm step

capabilities.title: Two-step Taken
capabilities.text: Taken asks you to confirm. The dose is logged once, the count drops by one, and the next dose shows. Opening it again does not log it twice.

proofs.caption: Step 2 of 2: did you take this dose?
Dose recorded, 29 left, next dose showing
Opening it again: already recorded, not logged twice

capabilities.title: Cancel logs nothing
capabilities.text: The red Cancel backs out of a confirm. Nothing is added to your history and the dose stays due.

capabilities.title: Snooze and skip
capabilities.text: Snooze for 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes (it never marks a dose taken). Skip asks you to confirm and takes an optional note.

proofs.caption: Remind me again: pick the time
Skip this dose? Confirm, or keep it open

capabilities.title: Overdue dose
capabilities.text: A late dose is flagged plainly with how late it is, and Taken, Snooze and Skip stay open.

capabilities.title: Today and the week
capabilities.text: Today's Doses shows each dose as taken, due or overdue, with a progress bar, plus Day view and Week view.

capabilities.title: My medications
capabilities.text: A list with Active, Paused and Stopped tabs, an info page per medication, and actions: Edit, Pause, Stop, Log a refill, Delete (history stays).

proofs.caption: My Medications: supply and next time
Medication Info: photos, schedule, supply, reminder

capabilities.title: Refills and supply
capabilities.text: Low-supply warning, run-out date at your pace, log a refill, or fix the count by hand.

capabilities.title: History and Undo
capabilities.text: Every action is stamped. Undo walks back up to 50 steps.

capabilities.title: Emergency
capabilities.text: A favorites call list. Every call asks first, 911 sits behind its own confirm page, and the phone app opens; it never calls by itself.

capabilities.title: Personal records
capabilities.text: Personal Info, Medical History, a Health Diary and Documents (photos of cards and papers), kept on the phone.

capabilities.title: Appointments
capabilities.text: Appointments with reminders a day before, an hour before and at the time.

capabilities.title: Desk Display
capabilities.text: A stay-awake screen with the next dose, a clock and Emergency, which turns into the dose reminder at dose time.

capabilities.title: Your data
capabilities.text: Export a full backup, a spreadsheet (CSV) copy, and import/restore, all free. A doctor report comes with the one-time unlock.

capabilities.title: Photos and label reading
capabilities.text: Pill and label photos stay on the phone. The app can read the label text on the phone for you to check; it never fills in a dose by itself.

capabilities.title: Profiles
capabilities.text: With the one-time unlock, keep separate medications and history for each person; all their reminders ring on this phone.

proofs.caption: Profiles: one person now, more with the unlock

capabilities.title: Settings and test reminder
capabilities.text: Alarm and sound, snooze length, per-med alarms, display and phone permissions in one place. Test reminder lets you see a reminder before you rely on it.

capabilities.title: Light or dark, bigger text
capabilities.text: Medical light, Pulse dark or follow the phone, switched with the eye on every screen. Text size Standard, Large or Extra large.

capabilities.title: Help and support
capabilities.text: What's New for this version, a four-card tour you can replay, and Report a Problem, which opens an email draft you review before sending.

proofs.caption: Report a Problem: you review the email first

capabilities.title: Offline and private
capabilities.text: No account, no subscription, no ads. Your records stay on the phone.

demo.caption: 24 seconds on the test bench: home with the dose due now, Today's Doses, My Medications, all 12 doors, Pulse dark and back, and the menu.
